|lore=Male Trandoshan '''bounty hunter'''. Strong but clumsy. Extremely proud and arrogant. Suffered a humiliating defeat at the hands of Chewbacca and his partner Han Solo.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Power +3 at same site as a smuggler. While with opponent’s smuggler or Wookiee, opponent draws no more than one battle destiny here. Immune to attrition < number of opponent's smugglers on table.
|printings={{Card versions/Bossk (Dagobah)}}
|notes=The Players Committee released the original-layout slip for Bossk on 30 May 2003. The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Bossk (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Bossk (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The [[:File:Dagobah-D-bossk-decipher-archive.gif|Decipher base card]] supplies Pilot and Warrior through the original slip’s cutout. The remastered slip prints both icons. Both editions give the same pilot and smuggler bonuses, the same opponent battle destiny cap and the same attrition immunity threshold.
